versions.changelog: 错误签名通用化：提炼通用规律，不绑定具体工具名，提升去重匹配命中率
修复 SkillSpector 扫描发现的两个中危问题：1) 移除 exec 脚本调用，改用 edit 工具进行文本替换；2) 增加用户确认步骤，所有修改不再自动执行

- 移除了文档文件 skill-card.md。
- 其他功能与文档未做调整，本版本为一次简化和整理。

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No functional or behavioral changes to the skill logic or documentation.
- Internal project cleanup to remove unused documentation files.
移除淘汰机制，改为三拍机制（去重+压缩+计数）；无上限
新增去重/压缩/计数/淘汰机制；3类分类体系；TOOLS.md 报错记录区

- Initial release of zhheo-session-errorreview skill.
- When triggered by "报错回顾," gathers all tool errors from the current session, analyzes root causes, and applies fixes to SKILL.md or logs to TOOLS.md as appropriate.
- Provides users with a structured Chinese-language report summarizing detected errors, causes, classifications, and changes made.
- Includes safeguards: avoids modifying OpenClaw internal skills and ensures only local skill files are edited.
- Supports automated error review and self-improving documentation based on real session issues.
